method: Independent derivation and numeric verification, separate from rendered appearance
derivation: The two line families have normals n₁=(1,0), n₂=(cosθ,sinθ). Their relative phase changes by one line pitch p over normal distance p/|n₂−n₁|=p/(2sin(θ/2)). Equal phase repeats at that distance. The zero-angle matching case has no finite recurring broad bands.
limitations: Geometric occlusion model, not a wave diffraction calculation.
Rasterization can create artifacts, so the actual fine-line image still requires inspection.
